blurb: Guests join private fishing charters on one of the largest fleets of fishing and cruising boats on the West Coast. They fish for salmon, set Dungeness crab pots, and on longer trips set prawn traps for Wild BC Spot Prawns. Sightseeing and cruising tours of Vancouver and the Gulf Islands are also offered with lunch and island-ocean scenery.
extraNote: Reservations required, call or email to check availability · Marina office located centrally in Vancouver on Granville Island · Winter Season 2025

quotes.text: Our experienced and knowledgeable guides cater to the single angler or groups, aboard safe, well equipped and comfortable boats. We are open year-round with covered and heated boats. Novice or expert, you will enjoy our guidance and professionalism. We can organize your charter for just a few hours or several days, providing you with a lifetime of memories....
